q-0273.answer: Fasting in Ramadan is ordained in the Quran (2:183–185) so believers may attain taqwa (God-consciousness). It teaches patience, gratitude, and empathy for those who are hungry.

q-0369.answer:
Surah Al-Kahf (18) — The Cave · 110 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• To those who oppose His Prophet ﷺ and disbelieve in His Book, He issues a warning of severe punishment hastened in this world and postponed to the world Hereafter.
• Their overwhelming punishment, destroying every last one of them.
• This thing that I did deliberately is one of the things I told you not to denounce me for, because you do not know the full story, and there is a reason and purpose for it that you do not know about.
• It has no basis apart from what they say, and they have no evidence for it apart from their own lies and fabrications.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.

q-0567.answer:
Surah Al-Mulk (67) — The Sovereignty · 30 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Exhausted and broken down feebleness due to the great amount of repeated looking without being able to detect any deficiency.
• The place of return on the Day of Judgement.
• Allah's Power to create and It being an Evidence of the Final Abode
• Reminding of Allah's Blessing by the springing of Water and the Threat of It being taken away
• Travel wherever you wish throughout its regions and frequent its countrysides and all the areas of its domain in your various journeys to seek earnings and trade.

Full ayah text and tafsir are available in the sources below.
